color.note: Blue Book colours are exact (named tokens, each scale's 500, greys 100, 300 and 700). Four styles (calm, warm, bold, playful), each light and dark; neutrals carry the interface, AIESEC Blue marks action, status and programme colours stay small. Build with semantic tokens; scales are for tints and data.

tokens.name: ae-white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Light surfaces, text on primary and dark fills, white logo variants.

tokens.name: ae-black
tokens.usage: Pure black. Only as the background of the black logo variant; never for UI text (use `ae-text`).

tokens.name: ae-bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: ae-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Secondary areas: sidebars, footers, table headers, wells.

tokens.name: ae-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, table bodies.

tokens.name: ae-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything floating: menus, popovers, modals, toasts (with a shadow).

tokens.name: ae-fill
tokens.usage: Neutral hover and soft-button fill.

tokens.name: ae-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Neutral pressed fill and the current item in navigation.

tokens.name: ae-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the mobile navigation drawer.

tokens.name: ae-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, card outlines. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ae-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (inputs, checkboxes, radios). 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: ae-text
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on every surface, fill and soft tint.

tokens.name: ae-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, metadata, placeholders, inactive navigation, labels of disabled controls. AA on every surface and fill.

tokens.name: ae-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled values only (WCAG exempts disabled controls). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: ae-ink
tokens.usage: The strongest neutral fill. Marks place: the current page in pill navigation, a selected filter chip, tooltips.

tokens.name: ae-on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-ink`.

tokens.name: ae-neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral solid fill: count badges and neutral states (draft, archived).

tokens.name: ae-on-neutral
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-neutral`.

tokens.name: ae-brand
tokens.usage: AIESEC Blue in every theme: hero bands, logo tiles, watermark tabs, brand moments (one large field per page at most). Not for small text or buttons (use `ae-primary`).

tokens.name: ae-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-brand`: large text (24px+, or 19px+ bold), icons and logos only (3.98:1).

tokens.name: ae-primary
tokens.usage: The action colour: the one primary button per view, checked and selected form controls, progress. White text passes AA on it in every theme, so dark themes never glow.

tokens.name: ae-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on `ae-primary` fills: darker in light themes, a touch lighter in dark ones.

tokens.name: ae-primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed `ae-primary` fills.

tokens.name: ae-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the primary fills.

tokens.name: ae-primary-text
tokens.usage: Links and blue text at any size. AA on every surface and on `ae-primary-soft`.

tokens.name: ae-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Faint blue: the selected option in a list, text selection, the info tint.

tokens.name: ae-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: ae-info
tokens.usage: Info status fill. Alias of `ae-primary`: information is AIESEC Blue.

tokens.name: ae-on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-info`.

tokens.name: ae-info-text
tokens.usage: Info text and icons on surfaces and on `ae-info-soft`.

tokens.name: ae-info-soft
tokens.usage: Info tint: alert and badge backgrounds.

tokens.name: ae-success
tokens.usage: Success: completed, approved, realized. Solid fill for small marks and the confirm button of a destructive action. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: ae-on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-success`.

tokens.name: ae-success-text
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surfaces and on `ae-success-soft`.

tokens.name: ae-success-soft
tokens.usage: Success tint: a faint wash behind alerts and badges, never a large area.

tokens.name: ae-warning
tokens.usage: Warning: needs attention, pending, nearing a limit. Small solid marks only (a count, a meter); dark text on it (`ae-on-warning`).

tokens.name: ae-on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-warning`.

tokens.name: ae-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surfaces and on `ae-warning-soft`.

tokens.name: ae-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tint: a faint wash behind alerts and badges, never a large area.

tokens.name: ae-danger
tokens.usage: Danger: errors, destructive actions, rejected. Solid fill for small marks and the confirm button of a destructive action. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: ae-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ae-danger`.

tokens.name: ae-danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger text and icons on surfaces and on `ae-danger-soft`.

tokens.name: ae-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger tint: a faint wash behind alerts and badges, never a large area.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

groups.name: Headlines
groups.note: The display family: Lato, the brand font, unless a platform with its own identity sets a personality font in --font-display. Display and H1 follow the Blue Book headline: a Light or Regular lead-in with the keyword in <strong> (Black 900). H2 to H4 are Bold.

styles.name: ae-display
styles.usage: Hero titles, one per page; keyword in <strong>. 40px under 640px.

styles.name: ae-h1
styles.usage: Page titles, one per page; keyword in <strong>. 32px under 640px.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Lato, the brand font. Keep paragraphs to `ae-measure` (68ch).

styles.name: ae-body-lg
styles.sample: Develop your leadership through a volunteering project.

styles.name: ae-body
styles.sample: We engage and develop youth to create a better future.

styles.name: ae-body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI: tables, hints, secondary text, small buttons.

styles.name: ae-label-sm
styles.usage: Compact labels: navigation group names, chart and table meta. Never a kicker above a heading.

styles.name: ae-caption
styles.usage: Captions, timestamps, badge text, footnotes. The smallest size: never below 12px.

groups.name: Programmes
groups.note: Raleway, the products font (the Blue Book programs font): programme names and programme-branded titles.

styles.name: ae-program-title
styles.usage: Programme page titles; the second line or keyword in <strong> (Bold 700), as in the programme logos.

styles.name: ae-code
styles.usage: Inline code and IDs (e.g. opportunity IDs).

spacing.note: 4px base. Use the steps; never in-between values.

tokens.name: ae-space-0
tokens.usage: Reset.

tokens.name: ae-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, badge padding.

tokens.name: ae-space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, between related inline items.

tokens.name: ae-space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (md), list row gaps.

tokens.name: ae-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile), field to field, grid gutter (mobile).

tokens.name: ae-space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), grid gutter (tablet), between groups.

tokens.name: ae-space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections in a page, grid gutter (desktop), page margin (tablet).

tokens.name: ae-space-7
tokens.usage: Large component separation.

tokens.name: ae-space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding (mobile).

tokens.name: ae-space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding (desktop).

tokens.name: ae-space-10
tokens.usage: Hero padding (tablet).

tokens.name: ae-space-11
tokens.usage: Hero padding (desktop).

radius.note: Calm defaults. The warm, bold and playful themes re-set these in bundle.css (rounder, sharper, rounder still).

tokens.name: ae-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, badges, tags, menu options.

tokens.name: ae-radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, alerts, toasts.

tokens.name: ae-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, modals, tables.

tokens.name: ae-radius-xl
tokens.usage: Photos and media frames.

tokens.name: ae-radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, switches, progress bars, pill buttons in the bold and playful themes, the circular AIESEC Human.

shadow.note: Per theme. Calm and bold stay flat and let borders work; warm and playful lift cards softly. Dark themes lean on lighter surfaces, not glow. Never on logos.

tokens.name: ae-shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Resting buttons and inputs: a hairline of depth.

tokens.name: ae-shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest (none in calm and bold).

tokens.name: ae-shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Linked cards on hover, the raised current item in a segmented control.

tokens.name: ae-shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, select lists, calendars.

tokens.name: ae-shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and toasts.

size.note: Control heights, hit targets, icon sizes and layout widths.

tokens.name: ae-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs in dense tables and toolbars (desktop only).

tokens.name: ae-control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and select height.

tokens.name: ae-control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero calls to action and touch-first forms.

tokens.name: ae-target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area for any pointer target (WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8).

tokens.name: ae-target-touch
tokens.usage: Hit area on touch screens (pad small controls up to it).

tokens.name: ae-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in small buttons, badges and inline text.

tokens.name: ae-icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons, inputs, alerts and navigation.

tokens.name: ae-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icons and icon buttons.

tokens.name: ae-icon-xl
tokens.usage: Empty states and feature highlights.

tokens.name: ae-header-height
tokens.usage: Navbar height; use for sticky offsets and scroll-margin-top.

tokens.name: ae-sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width.

tokens.name: ae-container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width.

tokens.name: ae-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for running text (60 to 75 characters).

tokens.name: ae-opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (with cursor: not-allowed). Never on logos: the Blue Book forbids changing logo opacity.

zIndex.note: Modals use the native <dialog> top layer and need no z-index.

tokens.name: ae-z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and select lists.

tokens.name: ae-z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky navbar and table headers.

tokens.name: ae-z-drawer
tokens.usage: Mobile navigation drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: ae-z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast region.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first: styles apply from the width up. Custom properties cannot be read inside @media, so media queries repeat these literals.

tokens.name: ae-bp-tablet
tokens.usage: 8-column grid, 32px margins from here.

tokens.name: ae-bp-desktop
tokens.usage: 12-column grid, sidebar shown, desktop navigation.

tokens.name: ae-bp-wide
tokens.usage: Content stops at `ae-container`; margins grow.
